title: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records & CSV: Subjunctive & Directives
workplace_track: 21 CFR Part 11 Electronic Records & Data Integrity
description: Master mandatory subjunctive constructions and regulatory modal directives in 21 CFR Part 11 electronic records, audit trail reviews, and CSV documentation.
learning_objectives: Use the mandative subjunctive (recommend that system be validated) in regulatory audit responses
Differentiate between 'shall' (mandatory regulatory requirement) and 'should' (guideline recommendation)
Formulate computerized system directives without Czenglish indicative shifts

questions.prompt: FDA guidelines mandate that the SCADA audit trail _____ active and unalterable during sterile compounding.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive requires base form 'remain' following 'mandate that'.
explanations.wrong_C: Continuous indicative is incorrect after mandative verbs.
explanations.wrong_D: 'must to' is ungrammatical; modal 'must' does not take 'to'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses the indicative or conditional ('vyžadují, aby zůstal'). In English, mandative verbs take the base form: 'mandate that it remain'.

questions.prompt: It is essential that every operator _____ a unique password and biometric identifier under 21 CFR Part 11.

explanations.correct: Subjunctive structure 'It is essential that [subject] have...' takes the base form.
explanations.wrong_A: 'has' is standard indicative, not the formal mandative subjunctive.
explanations.wrong_B: Stative verb 'have' cannot take continuous aspect here.
explanations.wrong_D: Modal past perfect is logically and grammatically inappropriate.

questions.cz_learning_point: English formal subjunctive requires base form: 'It is essential that each operator have...'.

questions.prompt: The Lead CSV Engineer insisted that all electronic batch records _____ before the QP release meeting.

explanations.correct: Passive mandative subjunctive requires 'be + past participle' ('be archived').
explanations.wrong_C: 'will be' is incorrect in formal subjunctive clauses.
explanations.wrong_D: Active voice is incorrect; records do not archive themselves.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses conditional ('trval na tom, aby byly archivovány'). In English: 'insisted that records be archived'.

questions.prompt: Regulatory directives state that system time-stamps _____ synchronized to a secure central atomic clock source.

explanations.correct: 'shall be' denotes a legally binding regulatory directive in GMP/GAMP standards.
explanations.wrong_A: 'should' denotes recommendation, whereas Part 11 compliance is legally mandatory.

questions.cz_learning_point: In international GMP and GAMP 5 regulations, 'shall' expresses a mandatory requirement, whereas 'should' is only a recommendation.

questions.prompt: The validation protocol requires that the automated autoclave _____ temperature limits within ±0.5°C.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'requires that' uses base form 'maintain'.
explanations.wrong_D: Adding 'must' inside a mandative subjunctive clause is redundant and non-standard in US pharma regulations.

questions.cz_learning_point: Follow 'require that' with base form subjunctive: 'requires that the autoclave maintain...'.

questions.prompt: Under no circumstances _____ allow another technician to execute an electronic signature under your credentials.

explanations.correct: Negative inversion: 'Under no circumstances' triggers auxiliary inversion ('should you').
explanations.wrong_D: 'will you' is a question or threat, not a professional prohibition directive.

questions.cz_learning_point: Negative prepositional phrases at the start of a sentence require inversion: 'Under no circumstances should you...'.

questions.prompt: The QA Director recommended that the GAMP Category 4 software _____ before installation on line 3.

explanations.correct: Passive subjunctive base form 'be re-tested' follows 'recommended that'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'was re-tested' is past indicative; subjunctive does not inflect for past tense here.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech uses 'doporučil, aby byl znovu otestován'. In English mandative clauses: 'recommended that it be re-tested'.

questions.prompt: EMA inspectors demand that audit trail logs _____ available for unannounced inspection at all times.

explanations.correct: Passive base subjunctive 'be made' follows 'demand that'.
explanations.wrong_C: Active voice is incorrect; logs do not make themselves.

questions.cz_learning_point: Verbs of demand require base subjunctive: 'demand that logs be made available'.

questions.prompt: It is crucial that the computerized system validation lead _____ the deviations before validation sign-off.

explanations.correct: Formulaic subjunctive 'It is crucial that [subject] investigate' uses base form.
explanations.wrong_B: Past tense indicative does not express prospective necessity.
explanations.wrong_D: Present perfect is not used in mandative subjunctive clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Adjectives of necessity ('crucial', 'essential', 'vital') trigger base subjunctive: 'crucial that he investigate'.

questions.prompt: The SOP stipulates that physical printouts of chromatograms _____ signed in indelible ink.

explanations.correct: 'stipulates that [subject] be signed' requires passive base subjunctive 'be'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'have been' expresses completed past, not future directive.

questions.cz_learning_point: Verbs like 'stipulate', 'mandate', 'specify' govern the subjunctive base form: 'stipulates that printouts be signed'.
